suggestions.title: Spinach and granola breakfast bowl
suggestions.steps: Wilt the spinach in a warm pan, top with a splash of milk and a handful of granola.

suggestions.title: Quick creamed spinach
suggestions.steps: Saute spinach until wilted, stir in a few tablespoons of milk, simmer 2 minutes, season and serve.

suggestions.title: Milk-soaked overnight oats
suggestions.steps: Combine oats with milk in a jar, refrigerate overnight, top with fruit in the morning.
